lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: We're not doing enough damage.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: We need to hit it harder!

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Penguin Squad, you're...!

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Hold on, Penguin.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Look.
The Island Eater's massive shadow begins to move.
It's going somewhere.
Ack!
*Rumble*
The ground starts shaking again.
But this time, there's something different about it.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: The island's... sinking back down.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: I don't think the Island Eater is trying to fight.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: It seems to be headed somewhere.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Let's wait and see what it does.
The shadow moves slowly but steadily.
It gradually moves farther and farther away from the island.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: It's... leaving.
A little while later.
Cinderella, Grave, and Mori return from scouting.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I think those last tremors were the Island Eater getting out from under the island.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: The island's settled back down to where it was before.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: We can even use the boat again now.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: The waves have returned to normal, as well.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: And the whirlpools around the island disappeared.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Siren, how are your bubbles?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: They're okay now.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: I think it was that machine that was making them unstable.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: After we destroyed it, they've been fine.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Good. I think that means we're all done.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Yayyy! We did it!
Tia hugs Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: T-Tia...!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Y-your hair... it tickles...!

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Hehe, yeah. We really did it.
Naga wraps her arms around Little Mermaid's shoulders.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Not you too...!

lines.speaker: peng4
lines.text: How sweet. Peng.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Very heartwarming.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Haha, yeah.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Everyone is so beautiful.

lines.speaker: peng1
lines.text: Peng!
Rapi pats Marciana on the shoulder.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Good work, Penguin.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Ace and the rest of you did great too.

lines.speaker: peng2
lines.text: Peng peng!

lines.speaker: peng4
lines.text: "The rest of you" is just mean. Peng.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I'm really, really relieved.
With the machines all destroyed,
are you ready to become a lighthouse?
Marciana watches Tia and Naga, who are happily celebrating.
A smile slowly spreads across her face.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I'm ready now.
That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Speaking of the lighthouse... Cinderella, Commander. Would you two help me with something?
Of course.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Sure. Let's go.
We head toward the lighthouse.
Using the portable generator we found earlier, we again turn on the light in the lighthouse.
It's too bad you can't see the light very well during the daytime.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: It's still beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: And it will be even more beautiful at night.

lines.speaker: peng1
lines.text: Peng!

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Yeah, I think it'll be visible from all around.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Clearly visible, at that.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I hope it continues shining for a long, long time,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: to show people where they need to go,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: and to remind them of where they can always come back to.
Tia and Naga run up to Marciana.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Miss Marciana, here.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: We got you something!

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: We gathered these pieces of glass while we were exploring earlier.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: They're called sea glass.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Then Tia and I tied them together.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: It turned out really pretty, huh?

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: They say broken glass naturally changes into this over a long period of time.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: We have been together for a long time too,

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: so we wanted to give this to you,

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: as a token of how we feel about you.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Even after we graduate... we hope you don't forget us.
Marciana accepts the sea glass ornament with both hands.
The pieces of glass sparkle in the sunlight.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I don't deserve...

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: No, that's not right.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: It's so beautiful.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I won't forget you.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Ever.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I'm sorry for not doing more for you,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: for not having more faith in you,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: for not being there for you more.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Miss Marciana...

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: After you graduate, a whole new world will open up before you.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: It will be much bigger, much less familiar, and you'll have to navigate it by yourselves.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: But... you'll be okay.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: After all,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: you've already overcome so many hardships to make it this far.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: And I can say that,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: because I've been there the whole time, watching over you.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Always have faith in yourselves, and keep moving forward.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: You'll do great.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Getting to meet you and be your teacher,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: and to spend all this time with you,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: has made me so happy.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Also, there's something I should've said much earlier.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: From the bottom of my heart,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: congratulations to you both on graduating.
Tia and Naga both wrap their arms around Marciana.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Wha...?

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: ... Miss Marciana.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: A long time ago, I actually used to dream of being a teacher.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: I kinda gave up on the idea as I continued to go to school,

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: but spending time with you on this trip has made me want to be one again.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: I know I may be graduating, but you'll always be my teacher.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Miss Marciana...

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Because you were willing to come on this trip with us,

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: I got to see real-life lizards, the kind I'd only ever dreamed about,

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: and make new friends,

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: and make tons of memories that I'll never forget.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: So... thank you.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Yeah... thank you.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: You don't need to thank me.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I only did what a teacher should naturally do.
The three of them stay in each other's arms for quite a while.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: All right, it's finally time to have some fun.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Time for the vacation to begin.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: But we have to leave soon...
Everyone pretty much gave up on the idea of this being a vacation.
I'm sure it's fine to have at least one day of fun.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Yeah, exactly!

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: We came here for our graduation trip and barely got to have any real fun.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: I'd like to hang out more with Siren. Hehe.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Ah woo ah...!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: That sounds wonderful.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I think one day should be fine, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can stand on the surfboard for twenty seconds now. I wanna see if I can ride it for longer!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It's training, not surfing.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Y-yeah, of course! And I'm saying I want to train more!

lines.speaker: peng3
lines.text: ... Peng.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I would also appreciate the extra time, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: peng1
lines.text: Peng!
Penguin No. 1 clings tightly to Cinderella.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Hehe, all right.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: If we're going to have fun, let's not hold back. No regrets, okay?

lines.speaker: peng2
lines.text: Peng peng!

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Yayyy!

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: I like the sound of that!

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Let's go have some fun!

lines.speaker: peng4
lines.text: Charge! Peng!
Everyone runs toward the ocean.
I move to join them...
but then feel something.
Someone's grabbing my sleeve.
Hm?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: P-Prince, just one moment.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: ... Here. A gift.
Sea glass?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Yeah. I made one of these while Naga and Tia were making theirs.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: The sea glass was so pretty, it made me think... maybe you'd like it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: You know, I hope the next time we meet...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: we can talk more about all sorts of things...  I'd like that.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: R-right now it's hard because of my eyes, but... next time hopefully I can see you properly...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Ah, ah woo...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Anyway... see you again, Prince!
Little Mermaid runs toward the ocean.
Gah! Where'd you come from?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Right now, you were just thinking, "She's cute," weren't you?
N-no!

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: You're blushing, Commander.
... Stop teasing me.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Fine. Let's go have some fun.
Yeah, let's go!
Rapi and I run toward the ocean too.
